comment: Gamebryo engine TUs for tools/progress.py engine mode (tools/gbtree.py documents the format). Generated once (2026-10-17, gb1) from work/ext/v2525/x/ms2decomp/units.json (recipe v2525) and the build/gamebryo-msvc ninja compdb (recipe stock), then hand-edited: generated include dirs -> $(TREE)/stock/, SWIG LuaWrap sources -> $(SDK) (the SDK's VC90 Release copies). This file is the source of truth; edit it directly. 2026-10-18 gb4: dropped v2525 twins of stock TUs except those where v2525 matches functions no stock obj matches. 2026-10-20 gb5: GameFramework TUs define MS2_ENTITY_PROPERTY_CACHE (egf::Entity's MS2 property cache, see egf/Entity.h). 2026-10-20 gb9: include lists with the PhysX SDK get src/ms2/physx2846 + the SDKs dir before Physics/include (the 2.8.4.6 NxScene vtable overlay, as cmake/ms2-engine-flags.cmake). 2026-10-23 gb18: egmWhitebox + egmPhysXWhitebox imported into engine/gamebryo/GameFramework (stock units replace the v2525 PhysXWhiteboxService unit). 2026-10-24 gb18: the stock flag sets with efd (28-31, 33) define EE_USE_PER_THREAD_ALLOCATOR_POOLS=0 like the v2525 sets and cmake/ms2-engine-flags.cmake: the exe engine has the plain pool statics (CreateFreeMem<unsigned __int64> 0x140d84660 stores to ms_pkFreeMem 0x143afaa80 directly; the NiTPointerAllocator initializer 0x140122ab0 only builds the CriticalSection, no TlsAlloc), while OS.h's default 1 made them efd::ThreadLocal and left the game's 71 references unresolved in the full-exe link.
